decanter-2019.name: Decanter, Brunello di Montalcino 2019 full report
decanter-2019.note: Decanter score known only from a search-result summary; page is paywalled and was not read. Rating 5/5. Also the source of the volume figures (13.1m bottles) as relayed in a search summary.

claims.claim: Winter and spring were wet, building water reserves. The first half of the year was cool and humid, and spring rain briefly paused bud growth.
claims.note: Two sources agree. A search summary says budburst was early, at the end of March, which does not fit a delayed cycle.

claims.claim: Flowering in May was staggered, with cool north winds. No frost or hail was reported in the sources read.
Summer was warm and steady from June, with no heatwaves and no heavy rain. Day-night swings reached up to 20C at Altesino.
Rain of over 45 mm fell on 15 September, and ripening afterward was slow and even.
Picking began in mid-September in the south and finished in early October in the north.
claims.note: One source. A search summary says the harvest began at the end of September.

claims.claim: The crop was large, a record at Tenuta Buon Tempo. The Consorzio bottle count is reported as 13.1 million, the most in five years.
claims.note: The bottle count is from a search summary.

claims.claim: Sangiovese is powerful and elegant, balanced, with strong colour and aromatics, a pronounced acidity and a complex, long-lived profile. Nearly every Riserva producer made a Riserva.
A more mixed view says only some wines stand out and areas and producers differ.
The Consorzio rated 2019 five stars, 'outstanding'. Decanter reportedly gives 5/5.

conflicts: Cycle: cool, humid and slightly delayed (Italy's Finest Wines) versus early budburst at the end of March (search summary).
Harvest start: mid-September in the south (Vinexus) versus end of September (search summary).
gaps: No Consorzio weather report. No official hectolitre figure read directly.

sheet.vintage: 2019 had a wet winter, a steady warm summer and cool nights. The crop was big and the Sangiovese is balanced, powerful and elegant. The Consorzio gave it five stars.
